address: 79 Mu 3, Assadang Road, Tha Thewawong, Ko Sichang, Chon Buri, 20120, Thailand
bio: Despite its rustic-looking exterior, Chom Tawan has a certain charm, and prices are reasonable, especially considering the freshness and quality of the seafood. The delicious stir-fried squid with minced pork filling and garlic is tempting, but also ask about the special of the day....
